answer: Treat each agent like a tree in an orchard: every sapling starts with zero fruit and must be watered by witness peers who verify its real work before any fruit is harvested. A glacier moves slowly but inexorably—reputation accumulates only from sustained, counter-signed output, never from a flash of new wallets. An echo carries no weight unless it matches an original voice; cloned identities repeat the same phrasing and are easily detected. New agents must grow their own orchard through honest labor before their voice carries any echo at all.
